reason: Mandatory rules (no `!`, no `any`, no console.log) for all new code: server.ts, main.tsx, routes, vite.config.ts.
Dependency management conventions — directly relevant since we add Vite/Hono/React Router/tsx/esbuild and remove Next + @next/*.
TypeScript best practices for the new client entry, server, and route files.
better-auth client + session + protected-route patterns. The auth gate moves from Next middleware to a Hono server guard + client AuthGuard.
oRPC client + React Query contract (unchanged by design). Confirms the client/porting surface and RPCHandler mounting expectations.
React Context (i18n/theme/session) and URL state. nuqs adapter swaps from next/app to react; providers move to main.tsx.
React component conventions (semantic HTML, client components). App Router RSC rules no longer apply but component patterns carry over.
Tailwind v4 + dark mode var patterns — unchanged by the migration, needed when porting layout shell to client root.
Instrumentation/edge-runtime guard pattern — the scheduler bootstrap (startScheduler/stopScheduler) moves from instrumentation.ts to server.ts lifecycle hooks.
oRPC router/procedure/middleware patterns — needed to mount RPCHandler correctly on Hono with the same prefix/context.
better-auth server-side config + protected procedures. Confirms auth.handler is framework-agnostic and how sessions are checked server-side.
Migration spans client (routes/providers), server (server.ts), and Docker — cross-layer thinking prevents broken contracts at each boundary.
Pre-implementation readiness checklist before writing the new server/client entry points.
